اصطبنت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَنْتُ (iṣṭabantu) /isˤ.tˤa.ban.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# اِصْطَبَنْتَ (iṣṭabanta) /isˤ.tˤa.ban.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# اِصْطَبَنْتِ (iṣṭabanti) /isˤ.tˤa.ban.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# اِصْطَبَنَتْ (iṣṭabanat) /isˤ.tˤa.ba.nat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
